revisions.summary: From your notes. The opening now starts low and rises, with its stresses kept. 6.7–15.4 s is exactly as you reviewed it. The stroke you found too low is the short fifth answer of each bar: it is raised in every bar, not only the three you pointed at, and stays below the downstroke. The same low replies were added later in the piece where they were missing.

points.text: The opening as a rise: starts low, does not end high.
The fifth answer of the bar, raised here and in every following bar.
The landing at 23.49 is removed; two beats, at 23.35 and 23.62.
The two missing ones (a somewhat strong one, then a strong one). The same replies added at 36.2/36.7 and 38.3/38.9 s.

revisions.summary: From your note: the stroke at 15.44 s is way stronger. It is the first downstroke of the full band, and the downstroke of every bar is strong in this reading except three: this one and those at 24.16 and 30.71 s, which have the same strong drum. I raised all three; say if the two others should have stayed as they were.

points.text: Way stronger: the full band's first downstroke.
